scripts.api:fetch: curl -sf http://localhost:8080/v3/api-docs -o openapi/claims.json && curl -sf http://localhost:8081/v3/api-docs -o openapi/reporting.json && curl -sf http://localhost:8082/v3/api-docs -o openapi/notification.json
scripts.api:generate: openapi-typescript openapi/claims.json -o src/app/api/generated/claims.ts && openapi-typescript openapi/reporting.json -o src/app/api/generated/reporting.ts && openapi-typescript openapi/notification.json -o src/app/api/generated/notification.ts
